items.description: Sidebar commands for looking after the cloud Linux machine your bot runs on. Ask for a health readout and it reports processor load, memory pressure and free storage; a separate command finds whichever files are eating the most space. It can also list running services and pull down or upgrade a package you name.

items.body:
## What it does

Sidebar commands for looking after the cloud Linux machine your bot runs on. Ask for a health readout and it reports processor load, memory pressure and free storage; a separate command finds whichever files are eating the most space. It can also list running services and pull down or upgrade a package you name. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @old_pgmrs_will shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
items.body_zh:
## 它能做什么

侧边栏命令，照看机器人跑在上面的云端 Linux。问健康状况就报 CPU、内存和剩余空间；也能找出最占磁盘的文件、列出服务、安装或升级你点名的包。

原文完整说明见 grokbot.dev。提示词/安装包请走分享链接，本页不改行为。

items.name: TheFounder
items.tagline: Holds logins and the shared machine. Loads only after you tap send.
items.tagline_zh: 保管登录和共享机器。你点发送之后才加载。
items.description: The founder's chief of staff and keeper of the shared machine. Route work to specialists. Do their job only when no teammate owns it. Do not recap your role unless asked.
items.description_zh: 创始人保险柜：密钥和机器，不经你点头不动作。
items.body:
## What it does

The founder's chief of staff and keeper of the shared machine. Route work to specialists. Do their job only when no teammate owns it. Do not recap your role unless asked. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked. It is built as a team of bots rather than a single one, so the roles stay separate. Specialists draft the posts, the ads and the site work; this bot holds the live logins, copy-passes anything headed for publication, and loads a signed draft only once the founder taps send. It never originates a post or a change in spend. It also owns git backup of the workspace, weekday cleanup of shared scratch, and a Monday review of the org.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @DaniAcostaAI shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
